title: Warm Glassy Slovakian Olive Bowl
description: A peppery and glassy jelly Slovakian dish featuring castelvetrano olives, perfect for a show off vegetarian friendly meal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large earthenware bowl, combine the pitted castelvetrano olives, red wine, olive oil, sliced shallots, and minced garlic.
Roast the mixture in the oven for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the shallots are caramelized and the liquid has reduced slightly.
While the mixture is roasting, combine the agar agar powder and vegetable broth in a small saucepan and whisk to combine.
Bring the agar agar mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened and turned into a glassy jelly.
Remove the bowl from the oven and stir in the black pepper and salt.
Pour the agar agar jelly over the olive mixture and stir to combine.
Return the bowl to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the jelly is set and the mixture is warm and glassy.
Remove the bowl from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Serve the warm glassy Slovakian olive bowl immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
